d:
In this full episode of Alaska's Grizzly Gauntlet from Nat Geo Animals, survivalist Les Stroud gets up close and personal with moose northeast of Fairbanks, Alaska, to learn their survival techniques for braving the Alaskan wilderness.
Facing intense pressure from wolves, bears, and human hunters, Alaska's massive moose have retreated into dense, nearly impenetrable willow thickets high in the mountains. Les Stroud pushes into extreme terrain to track down these elusive giants in their hidden wilderness sanctuaries.
